_about: The layout rules for island/private/ (git-ignored). Prose and reasons: island/PRIVATE.md, Layout. Read by tools/private_layout.py (the report and the check) and .claude/hooks/private_guard.py (the Write/Edit guard). Names only; nothing private is described here. game/ holds only what the game loads, registered in game/live.json (notes/asset-lifecycle.md); rewards/ is the generated area, and rewards/retired/<date>/<original path> holds replaced live files. Rounds nest under a project (rewards/<project>/<topic>-<n>/). The flat rounds were moved on 2026-10-05; `moved` is the old-to-new name map for reading older records.

projects.skimpy: daring-outfit portraits and sets for the cast
projects.peeks: the first private peek scenes (bath, machine room, desk, office) and their redo rounds
projects.day1: the day-1 private scenes: hard scenes, the gate search, the pictures they still need
projects.characters: designs of private-only characters (the gate guard)
projects.library: scenes made but not used yet
projects.days: the pictures of the witnessed hard scenes of days 2 to 5 (rounds <scene>-<n>) and the promoted set per scene in d<N>/<scene id>/<n>.webp
projects.archive: September's gallery, round-27, round-28 and everything else retired

dirs.encounters: the scene pictures the plugins show, flat
dirs.portraits: the private portrait sets, one folder per person
dirs.models: 3D models the plugins load, one folder per model
